stemMd: Compared with a carbon–carbon single bond between similar atoms, a carbon–carbon double bond is generally what?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Always freely rotatable without changing bonding

options.label: C
options.textMd: An ionic attraction between two free carbon ions

explanationMd: A double bond includes an additional bonding interaction and generally has higher bond energy and shorter length than a corresponding single bond. Restricted rotation also follows from its pi component.

distractorRationale.e: This reverses the usual trend with bond order.
